name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya's journey into motorsport was a blend of artistic talent and practical skill. Growing up in Mumbai, she excelled in visual arts and developed a keen interest in automotive design. After completing her degree in fine arts, she pursued specialized training in automotive painting and finishing techniques. Her meticulous attention to detail and ability to translate design concepts into flawless paint jobs quickly earned her recognition.

Prior to joining Carlin, Priya honed her skills at a custom car shop, where she worked on a diverse range of vehicles, from classic cars to high-performance sports cars. She approaches her role with unwavering commitment, ensuring that every car leaving the paint shop meets the highest standards of quality and aesthetics. Her ability to adapt to the demanding environment of motorsport, coupled with her dedication to continuous improvement, makes her a valuable asset to the team. Priya is particularly known for her innovative use of color and her ability to create unique, eye-catching liveries that enhance the visual appeal of the race cars.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied in a high ponytail
physical.description: Priya is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always has a perfectly organized workstation.
Listens to Bollywood music through noise-canceling headphones while working.
Insists on using only a specific brand of microfiber cloths.
